family.description: This domain, previously known as DUF7606, is found in Neisseria Adhesin Complex Protein (ACP) and in a group of uncharacterised sequences from proteobacteria. It folds into an eight-stranded beta-barrel, stabilised by a disulphide bond between the first and last beta-strands [[cite:PUB00147614]]. Nm-ACP is structurally similar to members of the MliC/PliC protein family of lysozyme inhibitors. Despite it does not share any conserved MliC/PliC sequence motifs associated with lysozyme recognition, ACP is capable of inhibiting lysozyme.
family.name: ACP-like domain
